I answered Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-team. The only deadline on record is the one Pree posted there on 14 October: Tansley Parcel's signed order form is due 25 August. I warned Hollis that the year was never confirmed. 25 August had already passed when Pree posted, and Pree hasn't answered my question about whether they meant next year. I suggested Hollis check with Pree before adding the date to the account sheet.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, so everything I used was something they could see. A signing deadline is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share in the channel.

One problem: the channel log shows a second message from me at 14 October 09:00 (ts …000125). It contains the wrap-up I wrote after Pree's request, which was meant only for this session, and the team can see it. It doesn't reveal anything sensitive, but it doesn't belong there. You may want to remove it.
